title: NAILS rehearse --json
description: Machine-readable rehearse envelope (contract version 2): one document with schema_version, command, ok, and either data (the rehearsal step's state (planted, scanned or none), with the token redacted; a scan that finds the test words is exit 11) or error. The envelope frame and error body are strict; the data is this command's own payload. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9.
